channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Aug 26
item.description:
39 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Monument blocker health reduced; can now be destroyed with 1 C4 or 5 satchels.
  • Heavy pot helmet crafting cost increased to 2 sheet metal and 8 high-quality metal.
  • You can now select and command multiple livestock at once; they receive offset positions to avoid stacking.
  • Wood armour gloves now display correctly in the viewmodel.
  • Third‑person flashlight animation and blending improved.
  • Work-in-progress changes are currently in development.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Monument blocker health reduced; can now be destroyed with 1 C4 or 5 satchels.
  • Heavy pot helmet crafting cost increased to 2 sheet metal and 8 high-quality metal.
  • Medical honey bandage now heals 8 instant health (down from 10), heals 6 over time (up from 4), and costs 4 cloth (down from 8).
  • HQM ore spawns are now rarer and new rare HQM collectable spawns added.
  • Oil rig radiation will reliably restart after a server restart even if the force reset fails.

NPC & AI

  • You can now select and command multiple livestock at once; they receive offset positions to avoid stacking.

Vehicles & Submarines

  • Looting player bodies while mounted on a submarine is blocked; you must exit the sub to loot.

Visual & UI Fixes

  • Wood armour gloves now display correctly in the viewmodel.
  • Third‑person flashlight animation and blending improved.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed collider read/write issues, improving hit detection and physics interactions.

Upcoming Changes

  • Work-in-progress changes are currently in development.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Aug 25
item.description:
84 development commits

Combat & Weapon Balance

  • Radwater now scales its damage with protection, dealing significantly more damage to fully equipped kits.
  • Flashlight weapon toggles on/off with right‑click, removing the previous F‑key activation.
  • Semi‑automatic pistol gains stronger damage falloff at range and its high‑quality material craft cost increased; SMG spawn chance slightly up and Rifle spawn chance slightly down for better mid‑game weapon balance.

Comfort & Environment

  • Bear rug provides 100 % comfort within 2 m and regular rug within 1 m, fixing the prior 25 % solo comfort issue.
  • Monument blockers at Launch Site, Military Tunnels and Missile Silo have adjusted protection values and health for improved balance.

Vehicles & Handling

  • Modular car wheels now use correct models and normals, and car handling has been refined – less body roll, fewer spin‑outs, higher‑speed drifting and smoother steering.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Added rabbit animal with animation, model, and prefab.
  • Russian roulette DLC textures and material updated, fixing naming issues.
  • Hackable crates now correctly flagged and visually indicated; puzzlereset alerts suppressed after forced restart.
  • Group tax displayed when hovering over upkeep cost in the TC loot panel.
  • Event crates and server gibs now persist across server restarts; fire state saved; crate despawn time reduced to 30 minutes; heli crates no longer land on unloadable train wagons.

AI & Navigation

  • Low‑resolution navmesh on ghost ships corrected, improving AI navigation on those vessels.
  • Fixed AI fleeing behavior when players jump, ensuring enemies stay engaged.

Performance

  • Optimized friend list refresh, eliminating lag spikes when authorizing friends to turrets in large teams.

Vehicles & Combat

  • HAB armour colliders fixed for proper removal on client and server, adding a collision mesh for the frame.
  • WireTool now correctly overrides third‑person idle/relax running stance, fixing tool animation.

UI & UX

  • Fixed session modal overflow and description scroll, restoring ability to disconnect from long description sessions.
  • Store UI now avoids sprite invalidation on opening, making all shop tiles clickable and fixing missing icons.
  • Added support for dynamic fullscreen and gallery sprites in store item overlays, improving item preview rendering.
  • Siren off state now visible, clarifying when sirens are inactive.
  • Cover images in store items now enabled after initialization, ensuring proper visuals.
  • Restored DLC prefab setup to prevent errors when clicking DLC tiles in the store.
  • Improved dynamic shop asset loading; empty tiles created on warmup then filled, stabilizing store UI.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Aug 24
item.description:
68 development commits

Combat & Weapons

  • Medkits now reduce radiation by 20, and longsword swings have a larger 0.4 radius with a faster 1.5‑second delay for more accurate attacks.
  • SAM sites fire proximity‑fuse missiles at drones, target 2.25× faster, can destroy drone‑dropped explosives mid‑air, and a new setting lets servers adjust the drone detonation distance.
  • Homing launchers now show a “Keep on target” label and their lock‑on timer is 30 % shorter.
